svg.text: DC jack 7-12 V or USB-C 5 V in -> 5 V (7805) and 3.3 V (AMS1117) out
7805 needs 7-12 V in. Heat: P = (Vin - 5 V) x I, so keep 12 V loads under about 0.5 A.
USB-C: two 5.1k CC resistors make any USB-C charger give 5 V. D2 stops 5 V flowing back into the charger.
D1 = reverse-polarity protection for the DC jack. D3 = protects the 7805 when only USB is connected.
SW1 switches the 5 V and 3.3 V outputs. VIN on the header stays on.
Power Proto Board: top rail = +5V / GND, bottom rail = +3V3 / GND.
Power Proto Board / Mini Power Module V1.0
